title: Mechy robot arm v4, run 2
headline: The gripper reaches down into the electronics bay; a folded elbow clips the shoulder inside its allowed range.

claim.text: Gripper meets the lower shank only past −135°

notes: None of run 1's 39 collisions were fixed; a bigger USB keepout added 9 more.
The reach rule bounds only the wrist point and fingertip; the gripper hangs 80–90 mm below.
